name: Might of the Old
summary: Strength +2 (max 22) and, once per Long Rest, Strength 25 for a minute. The price: Dexterity -2 and bark skin, Vulnerable to fire.

benefit.text: The oldest forests of Druskenvald pour their strength into you. Ancient Might: your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

features.name: Primeval Strength
features.summary: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: Strength 25 for 1 minute and double damage to objects.
features.text: As a Bonus Action you call on the might of the ancients to raise your Strength score to 25 for 1 minute, during which you deal double damage to objects. Once you use this Bonus Action you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

cost.text: That unchanging power pins you in place. Your Dexterity score decreases by 2.

features.name: Pyre's Price
features.summary: Using Primeval Strength gives you bark-like skin and Vulnerability to Fire damage until your next Long Rest.
features.text: When you activate Primeval Strength, your skin takes on a bark-like texture, and you have Vulnerability to Fire damage from then on. Your skin returns to normal, and the Vulnerability ends, when you finish a Long Rest.
